instruction: How many venmo friends have I made since the start of January this year?
notes: Fixed: the previous files were emitted on a single line so the `;` API comments swallowed the rest of the text; comments are now on their own lines. Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the model only chains passwords -> venmo login -> listing the supervisor's own friends (venmo.search_friends without query, page_limit 20; the agent iterates page_index until the result is empty) -> complete_task with the count. The answer is the number of friends whose friends_since timestamp is on/after 2023-01-01 (current date 2023-05-18, so 'this year' = 2023). The count object is a runtime value computed from the search_friends responses and is passed as the answer parameter of supervisor.complete_task, which is structurally forced to be the last action (all other actions require (not (task-completed))).
